notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: The random anomaly list has been corrected. The same anomaly types appearing one after another has been corrected.

notes.title: 🎮 Corridor Exit 8 is now available!
notes.content:
Are you ready for a horror experience where even your own senses can't be trusted?

You’re walking down an endless corridor. Every step is a decision. Spot the anomaly, or risk starting over. Make eight correct choices to escape no more, no less.

This isn’t about running from monsters. It’s a test of perception, instinct, and psychological endurance.
Minimalist, intense, and disturbingly immersive.

notes.title: Corridor Exit 8 - gameplay
notes.content: [p]We take a tour of the hotel level and the dungeon level. The basis of the game is to observe the environment. If something is not right, it means we are in the wrong place.[/p]
